title: EdgeCitadel Agent Contract Envelope
description: Wire format for all messages published to agents.*.*, tasks.*.*, or system.* subjects. See docs/agent-contract.md §1.

sender_id.description: Publisher's agent ID. Lowercase, hyphens/underscores allowed.

recipient_id.description: Required for command, result, delegation. Omit for broadcasts and lifecycle.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC with ms precision. Example: 2026-04-21T10:00:00.000Z

correlation_id.description: Echoed unchanged across a request/reply conversation.

causation_id.description: ID of the message that directly caused this one. Enables causal tracing.

chain_id.description: Shared across all messages in a delegation chain. Used for loop detection.

ttl_ms.description: Advisory drop-after-ms. Requires NTP sync; omit if clock is unreliable.

payload.description: Type-specific body. Per-type payload schemas are planned for v0.2.
